rationale: Goods receipt GR-7706 shows only 60 of 100 EACH delivered, with 40 on backorder, so under clause 4 the quantity resolves in favour of the receipt and payment is limited to the received quantity: 60 × $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3, no variance). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net gives $42.75 (clause 5) for a corrected gross of $612.75; the supplier's $71.25 is simply the tax on the over-invoiced quantity, not an independent tax defect. Single defect, no credit memos, so clause 11 escalation is not triggered and clause 10 puts approval with AP_CLERK.
